messages:
sara-sec: ParetoHealth sent back their security questionnaire. asks: example Okta->Redwood role mapping for Prod/Dev, signed tamper-evident audit export (90d), options for customer-managed keys (HSM vs KMS), and an incident replay procedure for forensic validation.

oliver-infra: we should present three clear key patterns: 1) customer HSM (keys stay in their HSM, PKCS#11/CloudHSM), 2) CMK-wrap (data keys wrapped by customer KMS in AWS/GCP/Azure), 3) service-managed keys (we sign audit bundles with our service key). note: importing keys into hosted HSM is not permitted.

sara-sec: also asked about FIPS and attestation. we can state FIPS-compliant modules in private deployments and provide attestation artifacts on request. include retention defaults (90d raw, 365d indices) and Dedicated options.

nina-sre: sample audit export flow: export -> checksum -> detached signature -> signed bundle upload -> audit event. commands: 
```bash
rictl audit export --tenant pareto --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-31 --format ndjson --out pareto-20260101-20260331.ndjson
sha256sum pareto-20260101-20260331.ndjson > pareto.sha256
rictl crypto sign --key /keys/tenant_envelope.pem --in pareto-20260101-20260331.ndjson --out pareto.sig --detached
tar czf pareto-audit-bundle.tgz pareto-20260101-20260331.ndjson pareto.sha256 pareto.sig manifest.json
aws s3 cp pareto-audit-bundle.tgz s3://redwood-sec/exports/3495000000-pareto/ --server-side-encryption aws:kms
```

oliver-infra: verification steps: provide public cert + detached signature verification instructions. for private installs, offer option to sign bundle with customer's HSM and include attestation statement.

sara-sec: incident replay runbook (high level): 1) create ephemeral replay tenant with egress disabled, 2) import signed bundle and verify signature, 3) replay sessions with `rictl audit replay --tenant replay-pareto --input pareto.ndjson --sandbox --block-external --session ID`, 4) collect traces and sign results for chain-of-custody. include RBAC guards (only audit-read/replay roles) and mandatory reviewer approval before enabling connectors.

nina-sre: add CVE triage SLA: critical assessment within 24h, mitigation/rollback within 72h where feasible; maintain dependency inventory and publish remediation notes. example: patched runtime shim for grpc CVE-2026-2001 with canary rollout.

sara-sec: action items: i'll draft the formal reply with RBAC JSON examples and attestation template; oliver will prepare a keyflow diagram and host verification steps; nina will write the replay checklist and guardrails. tagging @signing-bot to generate cert thumbprint.

signing-bot: cert-thumbprint created: SHA256:5f:ab:12:... stored at s3://redwood-sec/exports/3495000000-pareto/thumbprint.txt

oliver-infra: scheduled a call with ParetoHealth for next Thu, will include proposed migration timeline for Okta groups -> roles to avoid gaps.

sara-sec: thanks team, i'll post the draft by EOD tomorrow.
